headings.usage: Use for massive impact, hero titles, manifesto numbers, and section headers.

subheadings.usage: Secondary headings, package names, pricing numbers.

body.usage: Testimonial text, standard paragraphs, form inputs.

labels.usage: Small uppercase overlines, button text, form labels, small navigational links.

rules: NO generic full-screen gradients. Use solid dark tones.
Use #FF2A2A purely as a functional or high-impact accent (e.g., buttons, numbers, marquee background).
Never use pure black #000000, stick to #0A0A0A for rich depth.

layouts.grid_system: Swiss Brutalist (Grid Mode A: Tetris Grid). Asymmetrical layout, generous whitespace.
layouts.spacing: Scale up standard spacing (p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32). Do not cramp sections.
layouts.border_rules: Use visible 1px borders (border-white/10) for a technical 'grid' look in pricing or features.
layouts.header: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with 1px bottom border. DO NOT use completely transparent header.

motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic typography mask-image line-by-line reveal using framer-motion.
motion.scroll_animations: Staggered fade-up and scale-in as user scrolls.
motion.hover_effects: High-contrast flip. Example: black button with white border becomes red background, white text, no border.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero Section
sections_blueprint.features: Massive 'XCLUSIVE' in Anton font (text-8xl to text-[12vw]). Parallax background of steering wheel image (masked or overlaid heavily with bg-black/60). Floating 'est. 2026' or mono labels.

sections_blueprint.name: Editorial Marquee
sections_blueprint.features: react-fast-marquee with words: 'MANUAL • AUTOMATIC • INTENSIVE • PASS PLUS'. High contrast: Red background (#FF2A2A) with black text, Anton font, large text.

sections_blueprint.name: Manifesto / Why Choose Us
sections_blueprint.features: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) in massive stroke/outline text. Asymmetric grid. Monospace small labels outlining stats (e.g., '98% Pass Rate').

sections_blueprint.name: Course Packages (Pricing)
sections_blueprint.features: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Instead of standard cards, use a border-collapse grid style with sharp edges. No soft shadows.

sections_blueprint.name: Reviews Gallery
sections_blueprint.features: Image-focused. A slider or masonry layout using Framer Motion. High-end lifestyle imagery.

sections_blueprint.name: Contact / Enquiry
sections_blueprint.features: Brutalist form. Input fields should be transparent with only a bottom border (1px white/20). Massive red submit button.

components.name: Button
components.instructions: Sharp edges, rounded-none. Hover: invert colors or transition to red.

components.name: Form Input
components.instructions: Override Tailwind for a bottom-border-only look. No focus rings, instead brighten bottom border to solid white.

visual_enhancers.noise_overlay: Add a fixed pointer-events-none 5-10% opacity SVG noise layer to the entire site.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against black/red meets APCA standards. Use text-white over black.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='submit-contact-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a custom font configuration using standard Google Fonts imports in index.css.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do not invent new shades of gray or red.
Do not use generic border-radius (keep it sharp rounded-none for brutalist feel unless explicitly needed).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
